The test `['pandas.tests.series.methods.test_to_period.TestToPeriod.test_to_period_raises()']` failed.
The test looks like:

```python
50 :     def test_to_period_raises(self, indices):
51 :         # https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/issues/33327
52 :         index = indices
53 :         ser = Series(index=index, dtype=object)
54 :         if not isinstance(index, DatetimeIndex):
55 :             msg = f"unsupported Type {type(index).__name__}"
56 :             with pytest.raises(TypeError, match=msg):
57 :                 ser.to_period() # error occurred here
```

It failed with the following error message and call stack:

```
E       AssertionError
>               ser.to_period()
pandas/tests/series/methods/test_to_period.py:57: 
>       assert isinstance(self.index, DatetimeIndex)
pandas/core/series.py:4714: AssertionError
```

4717 :             self, method="to_period"

The test `test_to_period_raises` checks whether the `Series.to_period()` method correctly raises a `TypeError` when the input index is not of type `DatetimeIndex`. However, the test failure indicates that this behavior is not being achieved. Following the execution path, we find that the `to_period()` method has an assertion to check if the series' index is a `DatetimeIndex`, and it fails because the `assert isinstance(self.index, DatetimeIndex)` condition evaluates to `False`. This happens because the input `index` in the test case is not being properly set as a `DatetimeIndex`.

Consequently, the error demonstrated by the test is that the assertion does not work as expected due to the incorrect type of the index.
